title: Final Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the energy required for the muon to reach the earth's surface as 3.3 GeV.

title: Deflection Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the formula for the radius of curvature R in the magnetic field and relate it to the deflection distance a.

title: Threshold Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately determine the threshold energy for the proton in the reaction as 1.82 x 10^11 GeV.

title: Direction of Deflection
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the direction of deflection for the muon in the earth's magnetic field.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of relativistic equations.

title: Energy Loss Mechanism
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the mechanism of energy loss for protons interacting with 3-K radiation.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should justify the zeroth approximation used for the earth's magnetic field.
